properties.description: Successful normalized Confidential or HighlyConfidential data access followed strictly later within 10 minutes by successful external tool submission in the same agent, session and nonempty correlation context.
properties.displayName: AI Agent | Optional: sensitive-data access followed by a non-allowlisted tool submission
properties.query:
let Agents = _GetWatchlist('AIAgentInventory')
    | where tolower(tostring(Enabled)) == 'true'
    | project AgentId = tolower(tostring(AgentId))
    | where isnotempty(AgentId) | distinct AgentId;
let Allowed = _GetWatchlist('AIAgentAllowedDestinations')
    | where tolower(tostring(Enabled)) == 'true'
    | project AgentId = tolower(tostring(AgentId)), DestinationHost = tolower(trim_end(@'\.+', tostring(DestinationHost)))
    | where isnotempty(AgentId) and DestinationHost matches regex @'^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9.-]*[a-z0-9])?$'
    | distinct AgentId, DestinationHost;
let ConfiguredAgents = Allowed | distinct AgentId;
let Events = AIAgentEvent_CL
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h) and SchemaVersion == '1.0'
    | extend AgentId = tolower(AgentId)
    | where isnotempty(AgentId) and isnotempty(SessionId) and isnotempty(EventId) and isnotempty(CorrelationId)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AgentId, EventId
    | join kind=inner Agents on AgentId
    | join kind=inner ConfiguredAgents on AgentId;
let Reads = Events | where EventType == 'DataAccess' and Outcome == 'Succeeded'
    | where DataClassification in ('Confidential', 'HighlyConfidential')
    | project AgentId, SessionId, CorrelationId, ReadAt = TimeGenerated, ReadId = EventId, DataClassification;
let Sends = Events | where EventType == 'ExternalSubmission' and Outcome == 'Succeeded' and isnotempty(ToolName)
    | extend DestinationHost = tolower(trim_end(@'\.+', DestinationHost))
    | where DestinationHost matches regex @'^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9.-]*[a-z0-9])?$'
    | join kind=leftanti Allowed on AgentId, DestinationHost
    | project AgentId, SessionId, CorrelationId, SendAt = TimeGenerated, SendId = EventId, ActorUPN = tolower(ActorUPN), ToolName, DestinationHost;
Reads
| join kind=inner Sends on AgentId, SessionId, CorrelationId
| where SendAt > ReadAt and SendAt <= ReadAt + 10m and SendId != ReadId
| summarize arg_max(ReadAt, *) by AgentId, SessionId, CorrelationId, SendId
| project TimeGenerated = SendAt, AgentId, ActorUPN, SessionId, DestinationHost,
          Evidence = tostring(bag_pack('readEventId', ReadId, 'readAt', ReadAt, 'submissionEventId', SendId, 'classification', DataClassification, 'toolName', ToolName, 'destinationHost', DestinationHost, 'correlationId', CorrelationId, 'assessment', 'Shared trace; transferred content not proven')),
          CorrelationQuality = 'heuristic', AccountCustomEntity = ActorUPN
